verdict.rationale: Supabase Auth's own docs say users can sign up and sign in with a Magic Link or email OTP instead of a password, which covers the passwordless half of the story. Nothing in the pack mentions passkeys or WebAuthn, and the documented MFA factors are only TOTP or phone. missing for 10: passkeys/WebAuthn sign-in support, in-depth documentation of magic link/OTP flows, independent or hands-on corroboration of passwordless sign-in.

support.subject: As a developer, I can offer passkeys/WebAuthn and passwordless options like magic links or email OTP as first-class sign-in methods

citations.quote: Sign up and sign in users with a Magic Link or email OTP instead of a password.
